quiz.question: A user emptied Deleted Items yesterday and needs an email back. Where do they look first?
options: The Recycle Bin on their PC
quiz.why: Exchange Online keeps deleted items recoverable for 14 days by default (an admin can raise it to 30). Outlook's Recover Deleted Items gets them back.
